text:
Alex: heads-up, getting a pile of p95/p99 reports since ~09:12 UTC for /v1/generate. p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~6-7s. Customer impact: timeouts and retries.
Priya: which regions/tenants? any pattern?
Alex: mostly eu-west and us-central, tenants: acme-inc, beta-suite, a few free accounts.
SupportBot: alert: latency-p95-rule triggered (service=ingress, threshold=1s, window=5m). incident id: INC-20260317-09
Jordan: checking runtime metrics now. worker CPU ~92%, io wait low, queue length per router ~350-480. inflight per worker = 48/50 limit for many pods.
Maren: admission controller logs show a bunch of "enqueue" -> "deferred" events when queue > 300. fallback route not kicking for some requests.
Kevin: can we see a small sample of the router log around 09:12?
Alex: paste below (sanitized):
```
2026-03-17T09:11:58Z router-12 INFO enqueue req=8f3c path=/v1/generate tenant=acme-inc
2026-03-17T09:12:01Z router-12 WARN queue_length=312 admit=deferred reason=worker_saturated
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z worker-7 ERROR process_start delay_ms=1200 inflight=47
2026-03-17T09:12:05Z router-12 INFO admit_policy=concurrency_window limit=50 window_ms=1000
2026-03-17T09:12:07Z worker-7 INFO kv_cache_hit=false batch_size=8
2026-03-17T09:12:10Z router-12 WARN queue_length=420 drop=0 fast_fail=0
2026-03-17T09:12:12Z worker-7 ERROR request_timeout id=8f3c elapsed_ms=6500
```
Jordan: looks like many workers hit inflight ceiling so requests pile up on routers. batching still active (batch_size ~8) which increases latency under saturation.
Priya: root cause hypothesis: sudden tenant fan-out + batch fusion causing long tail when workers saturate and admission control defers but doesn't fast-fail.
Maren: agreed. Also noticed autoscaler didn't spin up because node pool usage is high and quota bump blocked (quota request pending).
Kevin: immediate mitigations we can do now?
Alex: 1) reduce max batch size for the hot model route to 4 to shorten per-batch time. 2) lower per-worker concurrency limit from 50 -> 40 temporarily. 3) instruct routers to fast-fail when queue_length > 300 for free-tier tenants.
Jordan: I can toggle batching config and concurrency limit, but need a quick rollback plan.
Maren: I'll flip fast-fail policy for free-tier to protect paid tenants.
Priya: support comms: draft a short customer message for impacted tenants and for status page. keep it factual: we saw transient worker saturation and admission-control backlog, mitigation in progress.
Kevin: steps executed:
- Jordan: changed batch_size to 4 on canary routers (router-12, router-13) at 09:22 UTC.
- Jordan: lowered worker concurrency to 40 on pool-gpu-a at 09:25 UTC.
- Maren: enabled fast-fail for free-tier at 09:26 UTC.
SupportBot: config-change: batch_size=4 applied to canary routers by Jordan at 2026-03-17T09:22:05Z
Alex: after changes p95 dropped to ~280-320ms within 2m on canary, p99 to ~1.1s. overall cluster p95 at 09:30 ~420ms.
Priya: anything else to avoid recurrence short-term?
Jordan: request: temporarily increase desired replicas for pool-gpu-a by +20% pending quota approval. I've opened cloud request CR-7892.
Maren: add a guard in admission controller to fast-fail non-critical routes earlier (threshold 200 instead of 300) and incrementally ramp.
Kevin: long-term follow-ups:
- Investigate autoscaler cooldown logic + quota alerting so we don't stall scale-up.
- Add per-tenant burst isolation so single tenant fan-out can't saturate entire pool.
- Evaluate adaptive batching: reduce batch size when queue backlog detected.
Priya: support follow-up actions:
- Send customers impacted a proactive note with ETA and mitigation summary.
- Mark incident on status page and link to postmortem when ready.
Alex: repro steps for engineering to replicate in staging:
1) seed X clients (100) with high fan-out calling /v1/generate concurrently.
2) set worker concurrency to 40 and batch_size to 8.
3) observe router queue growth and latency tail.
Jordan: adding test harness task TST-453 to run this nightly against staging.
Maren: I'll own the immediate config changes and rollout plan to prod once we validate.
Kevin: I'll draft postmortem template and assign actions.
Priya: thanks all. I'll prepare the customer update now and ping once posted. :white_check_mark:
